premises.text: Enterprises must protect proprietary source code, but perimeter walls/alarms fail and ordinary encryption makes code unsearchable and unusable for software teams
premises.evidence_span: encryption makes your data completely unsearchable and unusable

premises.text: Overnest searchable encryption lets teams search encrypted data quickly without revealing the key, using AES-256-class security vetted by cryptographers
premises.evidence_span: search encrypted data as easily and as quickly as Google can search web pages, all without revealing your key

premises.text: Git Zero is encrypted Git hosting that encrypts code and history, builds an encrypted index, preserves familiar Git workflow, and keeps keys password-protected from the host
premises.evidence_span: the world's first encrypted Git hosting that not only encrypts your source code, at the same time, allows you to search while it's all encrypted

domains.name: searchable encryption and Git Zero hosting

value.text: Encrypt everything while still being able to search and use source code in the cloud with on-premise-grade privacy
value.evidence_span: you should encrypt everything and search anything

causal_links.evidence_span: they have to make a choice between convenience and security
